read.thesis: Record Q3 with 5% organic growth and full-year adj. EPS guide raised to $7.90–$8.10, but industrial coatings margins fell 260bp on index-pricing lag and Q4 COGS inflation is high-single-digit; no capacity cuts, aerospace capex expanding.

capex.quote: We are investing more than $500 million to expand capacity and improve productivity across the business.

triggers.label: Commercial actions offset COGS inflation in 6 months
triggers.quote: We achieved this in just 6 months, half the time it took in the 2021 inflation cycle
triggers.highlight: We achieved this in just 6 months

triggers.label: Industrial EBITDA margin 14.4%, down 260bp
triggers.quote: Industrial segment EBITDA declined 11% and EBITDA margin decreased 260 basis points to 14.4%

triggers.label: Q4 COGS inflation high-single-digit
triggers.quote: We expect cost of goods sold inflation to be in the high-single-digit range in the fourth quarter.
triggers.highlight: high-single-digit range in the fourth quarter

guidance.quote: we are raising the midpoint of our full year adjusted earnings per share outlook and narrowing the guidance range to $7.90 to $8.10 per share.
For the fourth quarter, we expect organic sales growth of a low-single-digit percentage
We expect total company adjusted EBITDA margin to range from a flat to an increase of 100-basis-points year over year.
Is about a $100 million combined between restructuring and productivity actions

red_flags.label: Industrial margin compression on index lag
red_flags.quote: Industrial segment EBITDA declined 11% and EBITDA margin decreased 260 basis points to 14.4%

red_flags.label: China auto builds cut ~8%
red_flags.quote: S and P has reduced their builds projection to China for something like -8%

evasions.quote: it is early for us to give our 2027 guide. You will hear that from me and Jamie at the end of January.
